decisions.reason: The electric infrared panel line is a flagship that fits the firm's push toward electrified, lower-carbon heating, so withdrawal within a year is unlikely.
The halogen heater is a low-cost niche product for outdoor and spot heating that costs little to keep, though it is the least strategic and the most likely to be trimmed.
The industrial electric hall heater line sits close to the core hall-heating business and meets growing demand for electric alternatives.
The hydrogen-capable dark infrared series is a strategic flagship with proven real-world operation and is central to the firm's hydrogen-ready direction.
